hazards: Full promoted state physically contains unknown_values including rules/printed/flavor/rulings content, artist identifiers, EDHREC metrics and marketplace metadata even though basic query output omits unknown_values.
Existing-public-Git in-place path/hash metadata is not a new permission grant to process, retain, redistribute, serve or export underlying content.
Five SourceRecords in the 40-file entity closure are a subset of eight canonical SourceRecords counted by Stage2; do not enlarge Tier A merely to make source_record count equal eight.
Two bounded audit files are required for exact entity provenance/query identity; only summary fields enter ordinary query values, but exact complete audit bytes are hash-bound.
Source references do not require source corpora to be physically copied into the Tier A core; historical source revalidation belongs in Tier C and remains separately permissioned.
provider-derived identifier namespaces include independent marketplace/Wizards/Scryfall identifiers; MTGJSON provider label does not establish rights for those upstream fields.
